metadata.description: Marketplace for the smooth-ai-report-review Claude Code plugins: a core follow-up workflow plugin plus optional ai-review-report and ai-analyse installs.

plugins.name: smooth-ai-review
plugins.description: Core follow-up skills: ai-review fix/skip executor and git-commit-review-push. Install this by default; ai-review-report and ai-analyse are separate optional plugins.

plugins.name: smooth-ai-review-report
plugins.description: Optional ai-review-report skill: the chunked review generator and local driver for the CI gate.

plugins.name: smooth-ai-analyse
plugins.description: Optional ai-analyse skill: the autonomous low/medium fixer for gate-authored findings.
